content.title: Speaking Test 10 — Music
content.description: The full three-part interview: music in Part 1, a long turn on “Describe a piece of music that means a lot to you”, then a discussion of music and society and learning an instrument.

prompts.promptHtml:
Let's talk about music.

What kind of music do you enjoy listening to? [Why?]
When do you usually listen to music? [Why?]
Have you ever learnt to play a musical instrument? [Why/Why not?]
Do you think your taste in music has changed as you have got older? [Why/Why not?]
Describe a piece of music that means a lot to you.
bulletsHtml: how often you listen to it
and explain why it means a lot to you

prompts.promptHtml:
Let's consider music and society.

Why do you think music is important in every culture?
Do you agree that traditional music should be taught in schools?
How has technology changed the way people listen to music?

Let's consider learning an instrument.

What are the benefits for children of learning a musical instrument?
Do you think music lessons should be free for everyone?
Is it harder to learn an instrument as an adult than as a child?
